meta.title: Gotovo — holiday rental cleanings under control
meta.description: Cleanings are created automatically from Booking and Airbnb reservations. Cleaners work from their phone with a photo checklist, and you see “ready” before the guest arrives. For apartment managers in Montenegro.

hero.title: Ready for check-in. Every time.
hero.subtitle: Cleanings appear on the schedule by themselves, based on Booking and Airbnb reservations. Your cleaner sees on their phone what to clean today and sends photos. You see “ready” before the guest arrives.
hero.note: Free until the 2027 season starts · No app to install

phone.label: Example of a cleaner's screen: four cleanings today, one done

pains.title: Three things that ruin the season

messages.title: You message cleaners by hand, every time
messages.text: New booking — new Viber message, and hoping someone actually read it.

time.title: Check-out at 10:00, check-in at 14:00
time.text: Four hours to clean — and you only find out nobody showed up when the guest calls.

review.title: “Poorly cleaned” in a review
review.text: You never saw the apartment after cleaning, and your Booking rating has already dropped.

calendars.title: Connect your calendars
calendars.text: iCal links from Booking and Airbnb — five minutes per apartment. Every booking creates a cleaning by itself, due between check-out and check-in.

link.title: Your cleaner opens a link
link.text: No install, no sign-up: today's apartments, addresses, door codes and a room-by-room checklist.

photo.title: Photos — and it's “ready”
photo.text: A task can't be closed without photos. You and the owner see right away that the apartment is ready for check-in.

notService.title: This is not a cleaning service
notService.text: Gotovo is a tool for your own team. You decide who cleans. The app makes sure no cleaning gets lost and warns you in advance if nobody is assigned to a check-out.
notService.alert: ⚠ An alert when a cleaning has no one assigned
notService.workload: Each cleaner's workload for the day

features.title: Everything for cleanings in one place

auto.title: Cleanings from bookings
auto.text: A new booking on Booking or Airbnb — and the cleaning is already on the schedule, due between check-out and check-in.

checklist.title: Room-by-room photo checklist
checklist.text: Kitchen, bathroom, bedroom, balcony. No photos, no closing the task — you see the result before the guest arrives.

issues.title: Issue reports
issues.text: A broken tap or a missing towel — the photo goes straight to the manager and the owner.

payouts.title: Cleaner payouts
payouts.text: Per cleaning or by apartment type. The monthly total adds up by itself — no arguments.

linen.title: Linen and supplies
linen.text: How many sets are in the laundry, where capsules and shampoo are running low, what to restock.

languages.title: In your team's language
languages.text: Montenegrin, Russian, English, Ukrainian and Turkish — everyone sees the interface in their own.

agencies.text: running owners' apartments on the coast.

owners.text: who are tired of Viber back-and-forth.

price.label: Pricing
price.terms: Minimum €10 per month. Pay yearly and get 2 months free.
price.free: First agencies — free until the 2027 season starts

calc.label: How many apartments do you have

pilot.title: Try it free in the 2027 season
pilot.text: Leave your contact — I'll reach out personally and help you connect your apartments and cleaners. No strings attached.
